card.name: Digits and commas inside round numbers
card.fires_on: Digits or thousands commas inside a number that is likely to end in zeros, such as 49,000, 8,000, 10 mg or 600 mg. It fires at the point where the next characters are likely to be zeros.

modes.label: Thousands numbers
modes.description: The comma or a digit inside a large round count, such as 40,000 or 8,000 pages.
modes.example: granted limited union rights to more than 40<<,>>000 federal workers who screen passengers

modes.label: Round dose numbers
modes.description: The first or second digit of a round dose in mg, such as 10, 400 or 600.
modes.example: with six months of Rifampin <<6>>00 mg daily

card.writes: It seems to favor the next character being a zero or a number ending, since zero-like tokens are suppressed only weakly and the promoted tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It activates partway through a round number, such as 10 mg or 40,000, where zeros are expected next.
